idea-plugin.name: Ticket Number to Commit Prefix
idea-plugin.description:
Saves you from typing the ticket key in every commit message. The plugin reads the key from the current Git branch name(if present) and adds it to the start of the commit message.

For example, on branch feature/TEST-123-implementation the commit message starts with TEST-123:

Features

  • Automatic prefix: a new commit message gets the ticket key from the branch as its prefix.
  • Insert Ticket Prefix button: a button in the commit message toolbar adds the prefix on demand, e.g. after switching branches or when a draft message is already there.
  • No duplicates: the prefix is never added twice if the message already starts with the ticket key.
  • Clear feedback: if the branch has no ticket key, is detached, or there is no Git repository, a notification tells you why no prefix was added.
  • Multi-repository support: the branch is taken from the repository the changes belong to.

Supported branch names

Any branch containing a "TEST-123"-style key (uppercase project key, a dash, and a number) is supported, e.g.

  • feature/TEST-123-implementation ➡️ TEST-123:
  • bugfix/AB2-7_fix-login ➡️ AB2-7:
  • PROJ-42 ➡️ PROJ-42:
